comment: Seed angle bank for the Rep Today creative loop. Every angle traces to a real mined pain in ../../01-research/pain-point-frequency.md with its real source URL. No results exist because nothing has ever been published.

angles.pain_state: Paywall or subscription gates everything; the app will not do anything until you enter a trial that converts to paid.
angles.verbatim_quote: you cannot use this app unless you pay for it. You just can't.
angles.hypothesis: People burned by hard paywalls will respond to a free tier stated as an absolute with no trial trap.
angles.hook: Free means the workouts. All of them. Forever.
angles.format: static card, hook plus Ready Screen UI
angles.preregistered_success_signal: saves per 1,000 impressions beats the angle-bank median over 7 days
angles.kill_criterion: bottom-quartile saves per 1,000 impressions across two consecutive 7-day reads

angles.pain_state: Losing a streak through no fault of your own resets you to zero and makes you quit the app entirely.
angles.verbatim_quote: That was it, back to 0, through no fault of my own.
angles.hypothesis: People who quit apps after an unfair reset will respond to a forgiving rolling score with nothing to lose.
angles.hook: Missing a day never zeroes you out.
angles.format: 12s screen-record video, missed day then unchanged score
angles.preregistered_success_signal: 3-second hold rate above account median over 7 days
angles.kill_criterion: hold rate below account median on two consecutive 7-day reads

angles.pain_state: Deciding what to do before a workout is the hardest part; excessive scrolling and clicks before anything starts.
angles.verbatim_quote: I need the app to tell me exactly what to do
angles.hypothesis: People with decision fatigue will respond to a demo where the session already exists at app open.
angles.hook: Open the app. Your workout is already there.
angles.format: 8s screen-record video, cold open to ready session
angles.preregistered_success_signal: watch-through to the Start tap above account median over 7 days
angles.kill_criterion: watch-through below account median on two consecutive 7-day reads

angles.pain_state: Prescribed sessions do not fit the time you actually have and cannot be adjusted.
angles.verbatim_quote: trying to finish up in 30-40 minutes what the app would have you take 60 minutes to do
angles.hypothesis: People squeezed by fixed 60-minute plans will respond to a 5-minute floor that still counts.
angles.hook: Five minutes on a hotel-room floor still counts.
angles.format: static card, hook plus 5-60 minute range shown in UI
angles.preregistered_success_signal: saves per 1,000 impressions beats the angle-bank median over 7 days
angles.kill_criterion: bottom-quartile saves per 1,000 impressions across two consecutive 7-day reads

angles.pain_state: Internet requirement is a dealbreaker; connectivity failures destroy progress mid-trip.
angles.verbatim_quote: It doesn't need internet connection to fully operate (workouts)... So it stays offline (forever).
angles.hypothesis: Offline-first demanders will respond to on-device generation shown with airplane mode on.
angles.hook: A session is ready in under 100 milliseconds, offline.
angles.format: 10s screen-record video, airplane mode toggle then app open
angles.preregistered_success_signal: comment sentiment naming offline as the reason, plus above-median hold rate over 7 days
angles.kill_criterion: no offline-naming comments and below-median hold rate after 14 days

angles.pain_state: Home programs quietly demand large gym equipment you do not have.
angles.verbatim_quote: Sometimes they used large gym equipment not typical for a home
angles.hypothesis: People misled by equipment creep will respond to zero-equipment as a hard boundary, not a bullet.
angles.hook: A floor, a wall, and five minutes.
angles.format: static card, person in socks on a rug, hook overlaid
angles.preregistered_success_signal: saves per 1,000 impressions beats the angle-bank median over 7 days
angles.kill_criterion: bottom-quartile saves per 1,000 impressions across two consecutive 7-day reads

angles.pain_state: Cloud load and sync failures destroy saved progress and stretch sessions past their stated length.
angles.verbatim_quote: Not being able to save your workout if you quit halfway through...none of my progress was saved.
angles.hypothesis: People who lost progress to sync failures will respond to everything living on the phone by architecture.
angles.hook: Built on your phone. Nothing to lose to a sync.
angles.format: static card, hook plus offline UI state
angles.preregistered_success_signal: saves per 1,000 impressions beats the angle-bank median over 7 days
angles.kill_criterion: bottom-quartile saves per 1,000 impressions across two consecutive 7-day reads
